d:
A win carries 3 points and Arjun was trailing MVL by 3 points going into this game. If he didn't win, it was almost certain that he couldn't top the group. How to approach a must win game? In this video from the Total Chess World Championship Pilot in Budapest, Arjun shows us the way! Commentary by IM Sagar Shah.
Video: ChessBase India
Edited by Ravindra Potawad
